caption: The drawing depicts two wooden sculptures of a human figure, both standing on rectangular wooden platforms. The larger figure is positioned at the foreground, facing forward and bending slightly at the waist, with its hands bound together at the wrists in front of its body. The sculpture is painted in a flesh tone, with numerous red marks and streaks resembling wounds and blood across the face, torso, arms, and legs. The figure wears a short blue-green cloth around its waist, and has black hair and a beard. The feet are bare and positioned side by side on the base. In the background, there is a smaller depiction of the same figure shown from the rear and side, revealing additional blood marks on the back and legs. This smaller figure also has a cord tied to its hands and stretching to the base. Both sculptures are set on wooden planks, depicted with detailed wood grain patterns in brown tones. The image background is a plain off-white, and there are handwritten notations and a date near the bottom left of the image.
title: Bulto (Penitente Nazarine Christ)
